bio.text: Joseph Hernandez is the Republican candidate for New York State Comptroller in 2026; the Post-Journal reported in February 2026 that the Republican State Committee nominated him at its state convention.
Spectrum News 1 describes him as a biotech entrepreneur who runs the investment firm Blue Water Venture Partners, which he founded.

According to Spectrum News 1, he fled Cuba for the United States with his family at age seven, attended the University of Florida and Yale University, and was on the 2025 New York City mayoral ballot as an independent.

sources.title: Biotech entrepreneur, ex-NYC mayoral candidate Joseph Hernandez running for state comptroller in 2026
Republicans endorse Hernandez for state comptroller
